notes.title: V2 released
notes.notes:
After a few years, I have updated the game once more. A few game breaking bugs have been brought to my attention, and with a LOT of research, it was partially the version of the engine and how I had things setup. I stepped away from working on the sequel, remake, and other projects to do this.

Fixed-
Level 3 boss area now will not stop you from entering the "Arena"
Parts of floor having no collision have had cement added to them
The poo will no longer fall from the sky
Monsters camping checkpoints have been removed/moved
Audio glitch of menu music playing through half game has been silenced
Final boss ganking you in the wrong level has been locked where he belongs
Drone boss de-buffed and super buffed at the same time

Not fixed-
NES sprite limit
Too many bullets sloooooowwwwwwwwwwssssss yoooooouuuuuu dddddoooooowwwwwwnnnnnn
Hey why am I invisible after I died?
Why do I have unlimited lives sometimes?
Ohhhh, if I try to backtrack I fall into limbo? (only on 1 section though)
The hidden warps are still not found? Weird...

What else? -
OR2 near end of dev, newer engine so less glitchy; but still NES limits
2 side games based on weird stuff? I am IN!
AN HD REMAKE BEING MADE?!? AND I GET IT FOR FREE WITH THE ORIGINAL?!?
Oh yay...a butt ton of reading with the new games...

More information to come, and if you find more bugs let me know. It may take a bit, as I am solo now.
Wil

notes.title: Ooze Redux coming to mobile and more!
notes.notes:
Hey all!!!


Ooze Redux is coming to Android phones, with the help of Argon Games. It will be in the next few days that we get the test version back!

We also have 2 new games in the works for you. Ooze Redux 2 - Mutation and A New Home - Skinworld. We are also doing an HD version of Ooze Redux, and a free game is almost done to give out to yall!

Big things coming, and my band Rejected Monsters is going to be doing the soundtrack for the HD version! YAY!!


Will​

notes.title: 3D "HD" Remake and physical carts!
notes.notes:
Hello all!

After attending and showing off the game at GameOn Expo, I have been given some major feedback and am going to be doing a huge update of bug-fixes as well as attempt to do another run of physical carts (physical carts will take a good 1k to make 100). The first update will be unlocking a level in the game that was previously removed, an overhall of bug fixes will follow, an updated graphic set for the player, and a release of the sound-track. I am also going to be doing a stand-alone "HD" version of the game in full 3d, free to those who already have the game.

I already have a few models finished and animating, working on the programming for the mechanics. 

I will be keeping everyone up to date on everything!
Below is a couple of stills of the early models of the 3d version! Expect a few updates with the added content and bug fixes for the 8bit version, and I will be posting progress of the 3d standalone version as well!

notes.title: Speedrun Trials!
notes.notes:
Beat Hippokitties speedrun time of 5:35 if you can! This will be a continual contest until the time is beaten!

The first to win will get a signed copy of the next physical game!

Winner will also have a custom level in an upcoming game!

Can you do it?

notes.title: Find the eyes!
notes.notes:
Through the comic that comes with the game is a load of hidden eyes. 

The first 3 people to find and submit where they found them will have a instant beta access to the next game in the series, with a custom character (that fits the game) of their design! As well as the beta of a different game we are also working on!

Can you find them?

notes.title: Steam Release
notes.notes: Our game, after a long kickstarter and such for physical release is now coming to Steam for yall to enjoy! We will be running a discount for the first week of release! After that a few more events to come!!
